name: Sheryl Shiganori
source:
As one of the children born with a shin, Sheryl experienced the effects of misfortune from an early age. But after a childhood full of struggles, she finally found a safe place that she could call home in Aurora academy.
Over the years she mastered her ability. As one of the stronger shin bearers, now she devotes her time to protecting other shin bearers.
People usually have a though time getting along with her, as she comes off as cold and emotionless.
While in reality she is a faithful, straightfoward and headstrong girl with a sweet tooth and a curious nature.
[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1881950/Reimei_no_Gakuen__OtomeVisual_Novel/]Steam[/url]]
